title: Color choice for self-reflection
subtitle: Short exercise · not a diagnosis
description: Choose the colors that feel most and least pleasant right now. This is an exercise in noticing your preferences.
comment: Color choice is not used to assess mood or personality.

title: Color choice: two rounds
subtitle: Exercise · not a diagnosis
description: Rank 8 colors from most to least pleasant twice. You can simply notice whether your choices changed.
algorithm: 1. Order 8 colors from most to least pleasant
2. Repeat step 1 without looking at your first result
comment: Color choice is not used to assess mood or personality.
